purpose: Teach: 浮遊/社会民主党/脱走/懲罰/移送/送還/駆逐/政務

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、宇宙空間の浮遊現象を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on weightlessness in space, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Light curiosity in the upswing. Genuine interest — not interrogating, inviting reflection. Steady and calm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、社会民主党の政策史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the history of social democratic policy.
lines.style: Measured, careful response. Slight pause before answering — choosing words. Respectful but grounded, not deferential. Clear and direct.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時下の脱走兵の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you explored desertion during wartime in your research, if I remember right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective tone. Gentle assumption — checking in, not testing. Slight downward cadence, like she's thinking aloud while speaking. Warm attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、近代の懲罰制度を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at how punishment systems evolved in the modern period.
lines.style: Even, steady delivery. Confident without being performative. Each phrase lands cleanly. Direct eye contact in her voice — she knows what she studied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 被災者移送の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also traced the history of how displaced people were resettled, if I'm not mistaken?
lines.style: Engaged and present. Warm acknowledgment of her work. Slight rise at the end — genuine question, not rhetorical. The tone of a teacher who has actually read the paper.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、不法滞在者送還の事例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the cases of undocumented immigrants and their repatriation.
lines.style: Composed, articulate. No hesitation — she's prepared to discuss this. Calm precision. A beat of seriousness underneath; she knows this matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 敵勢力駆逐の戦略を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And strategies for suppressing opposing forces in conflict — that was in there too, wasn't it?
lines.style: Slower pace now. Careful, measured. Reflective — not accusatory, but genuinely considering the pattern. Slight pause before 'wasn't it.' Thoughtful weight.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、政務調査制度の変遷を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I analyzed how the government research system changed over time.
lines.style: Steady finish. Composed and clear. A touch of resolution — she's standing by her work. Not defensive, but anchored. Slight closure in the cadence.
